status.description: answered when the native answer was produced; abstained when the model produced none or the runtime marked it low-confidence.

answer.description: The disclosed boolean policy's answer over probabilityTrue, or null when abstained. Not a claim of truth.

probabilityTrue.description: The prepared head's native P(proposition). EXPLICITLY UNCALIBRATED (DEC-08); null when abstained.

probabilityKind.description: Names the probability as the model's own, uncalibrated probability mass.
